text:
jamie: Anyone seeing a bump in partial/short streams from hosted today? Support flagged a few customer cases with truncated JSON at the end.

alex: Yes, saw 3 reports in the last hour. Not sure if it's network or model node. Where should we look first?

maya: Grafana panel for streaming agg is the best start — shows frame/packet metrics and disconnect codes: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/streaming/streaming-overview?var-cluster=prod :point_up:

sophia: Also check ingress nginx/client-close logs and the edge keepalive counters. Quick LogQL to see client closes:

```
{job="ingress-nginx"} |= "client closed" |~ "stream" | json | line_format "pod={{pod}} msg={{message}}"
```

ryan: FWIW we had a spike in `disconnect_code=1006` around 15:03 UTC, correlated with 502s from model-gateway-03. Could be short spikes causing KV cache invalidation and clients dropping. I'm going to query traces to link request -> model node.

alex: Can you paste a sample trace id when you have one? In Jaeger: service=streaming-driver and operation=stream-emit. Example query snippet:

```
service=streaming-driver && operation=stream-emit && tags.trace_id="<trace-id>"
```

ops-bot: Deploy notice: rolling restart of model-gateway group started at 15:10 UTC, nodes: model-gateway-01..04 -- monitor for 5xxs. :rotating_light:

jamie: Good context. I'll collect the customer trace IDs and a sample truncated output, then post here. If it's gateway restarts we might need to mute the partial-response alert until rollout finishes.

sophia: Agreed — suggest adjusting the alert to require >3 distinct client IPs or >1% of streams in 5m before firing. Less noise during controlled restarts.

ryan: I can make a PR to alert rules in Grafana/alertmanager, will ping for review.

jamie: Thanks — reopening this thread once I have traces. :thumbsup:
